source: Hisn al-Muslim (Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani) numbering; Arabic text cross-checked against the Quran.com Uthmani text for Quranic passages.
note: References use the common Hisn al-Muslim / Dar-us-Salam numbering. Gradings follow the published Hisn al-Muslim gradings (Salih/Hasan). Text is awaiting sign-off by a qualified reviewer; report any discrepancy from a printed edition.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi
items.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum...
items.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
items.grading: Quranic text; the virtue narration is Sahih (al-Bukhari)
items.variantNote: Recited once in the morning and once in the evening.

items.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq & An-Nas
items.arabic:
قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ۝ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad... Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbil-falaq... Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbin-nas...
items.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One... Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak... Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind...
items.variantNote: The three surahs together, three times each, morning and evening.

items.title: Protection from all harm
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.variantNote: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening is not harmed.

items.title: Refuge in Allah's perfect words
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
items.variantNote: In the evening; saying it three times protects from harm that night.

items.title: Allah is sufficient for me
items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim.
items.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
items.grading: Hasan (al-Albani) — the chain is disputed; see variantNote
items.variantNote: Some editions give seven times; the narration is graded hasan by al-Albani and weak by others, so it is optional.

items.title: Glorification one hundred times
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
items.variantNote: Sins are wiped away even if they are like the foam of the sea.

items.title: Tawhid ten times
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things.
items.variantNote: Ten times in the morning, or a hundred times a day.

items.title: Contentment with Allah, Islam and the Prophet
items.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
items.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam) nabiyya.
items.translation: I am content with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad as my Prophet.
items.variantNote: Three times each morning and evening; Paradise is guaranteed for the one who says it.

items.title: Morning has come by Allah's favour
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.
items.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
items.variantNote: In the evening recite: "Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna... wa ilaykal-masir."

items.title: The best supplication for forgiveness
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi ni'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u bi dhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Ant.
items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.variantNote: Whoever says it during the day or night with certainty and dies that day enters Paradise.

items.title: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer
items.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي
items.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi.
items.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek relief. Set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself.
items.variantNote: Reported for times of distress; also read in the morning and evening.

items.title: Seeking forgiveness after prayer
items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (3x). Allahumma Antas-Salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram.
items.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour.
items.variantNote: The istighfar is said three times, then the supplication once.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi after each prayer
items.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum...
items.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence...
items.variantNote: Recited after every obligatory prayer; nothing stands between the reciter and Paradise except death.

items.title: Tasbih of Fatimah
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (34)
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah 33x, Alhamdulillah 33x, Allahu Akbar 34x.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah (33), all praise is for Allah (33), Allah is the Greatest (34).
items.variantNote: Some narrations complete the hundredth with "La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah"; 33+33+34 is the more famous form.

items.title: No one withholds what You give
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
items.translation: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold; the wealth of the wealthy avails nothing against You.
items.variantNote: Said after the tasbih; some narrations place it immediately after the salam.

items.title: The three surahs after each prayer
items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ / قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ / قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad / Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbil-falaq / Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbin-nas.
items.translation: Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas.
items.variantNote: Once after every prayer; three times after Fajr and Maghrib according to some narrations.

items.title: In Your name I die and live
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
items.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
items.variantNote: Said when lying down on the right side.

items.title: Protection from the punishment of the grave
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
items.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
items.variantNote: Three times, with the right hand under the cheek.

items.title: Entrusting oneself to Allah
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bi-kitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
items.translation: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, and rely upon You, in hope and in fear of You. There is no refuge or escape from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
items.variantNote: If one dies that night, one dies upon the fitrah.

items.title: Tasbih before sleeping
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (34)
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah 33x, Alhamdulillah 33x, Allahu Akbar 34x.
items.translation: Glorification, praise and magnification of Allah.
items.variantNote: Taught to Fatimah as better than a servant; counted on the fingers.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi before sleeping
items.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ...
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum...
items.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer...
items.variantNote: A guardian from Allah remains with the reciter until morning.

items.title: Surah recitation before sleep
items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad, Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbil-falaq, Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbin-nas.
items.translation: Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas before sleeping.
items.variantNote: The Prophet would cup his hands, recite, blow into them and wipe over his body, three times.

items.title: Praise for being revived
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
items.variantNote: Said upon waking.

items.title: Seeking forgiveness on waking
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَعَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi radda 'alayya ruhi, wa 'afani fi jasadi, wa adhina li bi-dhikrih.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who returned my soul to me, restored my body to health, and permitted me to remember Him.
items.variantNote: Recited immediately after waking, before rising.

items.title: Dua al-Safar
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. Allahumma Antas-Sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-mandhari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.
items.translation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, though we could never have subdued it, and to our Lord we shall return. O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety and deeds that please You. O Allah, lighten this journey and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion in travel and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from an evil sight, and from encountering loss of wealth and family on return.
items.variantNote: Said when mounting the ride; on return add: "Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun."

items.title: Takbir when ascending and Tasbih when descending
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ... سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar when going uphill; SubhanAllah when going downhill.
items.translation: Allah is the Greatest (uphill); Glory be to Allah (downhill).
items.variantNote: Said during the journey whenever the road rises or falls.

items.title: Supplication on returning from travel
items.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
items.transliteration: Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li-Rabbina hamidun.
items.translation: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
items.variantNote: Added to Dua al-Safar when coming home.

items.title: When leaving the house
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
items.variantNote: It is said that the angels then say: you are guided, protected and defended.

items.title: When entering the house
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna.
items.translation: In Allah's name we enter and in Allah's name we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
items.variantNote: Then greet the household with salam.

items.title: Before eating
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah.
items.variantNote: If one forgets, say: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" (in Allah's name at its beginning and its end).

items.title: After eating
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimin.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.
items.variantNote: Said after finishing the meal.

items.title: Supplication in times of distress
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim.
items.translation: There is no deity except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
items.variantNote: Said by the Prophet at the Battle of the Trench.

items.title: Refuge from anxiety and debt
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by others.
items.variantNote: Recited in the morning, the evening, and whenever worry presses.

items.title: Allah is sufficient for us
items.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
items.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
items.variantNote: Said by Ibrahim when cast into the fire and by the Prophet at Uhud.

items.title: Supplication for the sick
items.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
items.transliteration: As'alullahal-'Azima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azimi an yashfiyak.
items.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.
items.variantNote: Seven times for one who is not in his final illness; "Allahumma Rabbas-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi Antash-Shafi" is another form.

items.title: Placing the hand on the site of pain
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا) أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
items.transliteration: Bismillah (3x). A'udhu bi-'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (7x).
items.translation: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah's might and power from the evil of what I feel and fear (seven times).
items.variantNote: Bismillah three times, then the refuge seven times, with the hand on the pain.

items.title: Dua when visiting the sick
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شَافِيَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shafiya illa Ant.
items.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm; heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healer except You.
items.variantNote: Said while visiting the sick, ideally wiping the right hand over the place of pain.

items.title: When entering the masjid
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
items.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
items.variantNote: Enter with the right foot first.

items.title: When leaving the masjid
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
items.variantNote: Leave with the left foot first.
